description: This file implements the DataElement class and LinkedDataElement class in the Thunder::Core namespace, providing CRC32 checksum calculation, buffer access, and data copying functionalities for data elements within the project.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with CRC32 checksum calculation capability.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A linked list node for data buffers supporting buffer access and data copying.

methods.name: DataElement::CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified buffer segment.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a segment of the buffer, handling boundary crossing via linked nodes.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets a segment of the buffer, handling boundary crossing via linked nodes.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another LinkedDataElement into this one, across linked nodes.
